Date: 2026-11-23T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Realtime output hangs observed during batch ingest - immediate attention requested

Karthik,

We started seeing sustained gaps in the realtime output stream beginning ~09:05 PST during our peak ingest window. Symptoms:
- p95 latency jumped from ~450ms to 12s+ for streaming endpoints.
- Error rate (5xx) climbed to ~4% (mostly 502/504) for the last 15 minutes.
- End-to-end throughput dropped ~40%; many clients observed incomplete responses.

This is customer-facing: our chat UI is intermittently freezing and several live sessions dropped. We captured request ids and short traces; attaching a trimmed logset and a small chart.

What we need immediately: a short triage to confirm whether this is an application-level regression, a model-serving slowdown, or an infrastructure-induced stall (chunked transfer / WS idle timeouts). This is impacting paying users — please prioritize.

Attached: northforge_streaming_log_20261123.jsonl, p95_latency_breakdown_20261123.png

Thanks,
Susan Li
Head of Product, NorthForge AI

From: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, ops@northforge.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-23T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Realtime output hangs observed during batch ingest - immediate attention requested

We completed an initial triage (quick summary):
- Root observed: a backlog building at the proxy ingress that coincides with a sudden increase in concurrent prefix requests. Proxy idle-time heuristics are keeping chunked HTTP streams open longer than the downstream model pool expects; this is causing KV cache pressure and long tail stalls.
- Evidence: multiple stream traces in the attached proxy_trace_segment.txt show 'chunked transfer: no bytes for 7-12s' followed by 502/504 from the upstream router. p95s align with the timestamps in your log.

Immediate mitigation (proposed, low-risk):
- Canary deploy at 10:30: disable chunked-transfer for the affected model pool and fall back to short polling/explicit flushes for in-flight sessions. This avoids long-open sockets while we stabilize the ingress.
- Patch: push a hotfix to proxy idle timeout calibration + aggressive reset for streams that show zero-byte gaps >3s. We expect the patch to reduce p95 by ~60-80% in preliminary tests.

I will kick off the canary in 20 minutes and monitor the following metrics: p95 latency, 5xx rate, throughput, and number of active idle streams.

Attachments: proxy_trace_segment.txt

—Dylan Brooks
Senior Site Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference
